Document type: adjuster_file. Page 1 of 2.

<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1330
Claimant:
Emma Chavez
Adjuster:
Christopher Wong
10-19-24
Claim reported by the claimant following a low-speed head-on collision at a residential intersection. Claimant states
they were the driver and reports neck and shoulder pain shortly after the impact. Claim file opened and the
policyholder confirmed as the named driver on the policy.
10-31-24
Reviewed the photos submitted by the claimant, which confirm the general location and the front-end damage to the
vehicle. Damage pattern appears consistent with the impact described in the first report. No independent witnesses
have been identified at this stage.
2-13-25
Spoke with the claimant by phone to go over the account of the collision. Claimant described the sequence of events
in the same way as in the initial report. Some uncertainty remains about the claimant's exact seating position in the
vehicle at impact, which I have noted for follow-up.
4-2-25
Obtained the repair estimate for the vehicle. Damage shown on the estimate matches the impact the claimant
described and the photos on file. No earlier damage to the vehicle is known from prior claims or inspection records.
4-30-25
Reviewed the medical records provided by the claimant. The shoulder injury reported is consistent with the type and
force of a collision of this kind. No prior injury to the same body area appears in the records or in the claimant's
history.
6-4-25
Treatment has continued somewhat longer than is typical for this kind of shoulder injury. I have asked the treating
provider for updated notes to confirm the current course of care. Nothing in the file so far suggests the damage
predates the start of coverage.
6-6-25
Reviewed the policy history and confirmed coverage was in force on the date of loss. Claim remains open pending
the updated treatment notes and the follow-up on seating position. Next review scheduled once those items are
received.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
